complete_pass.scope: archived-AMB rows (VER rows enumerate completely in first pass)

legacy_replay.purpose: archived-semantics replay: the pre-repair _compute_successor is monkeypatched back into the SCG builder; complete enumeration then reconstructs the archived critical-pair universe and certificate overlap endpoints. It validates the pipeline (legacy verdicts should reproduce the archived verdicts) and supplies the archived side of the critical-pair/overlap comparison.
legacy_replay.sample_rule: deterministic ascending sha256('legacy-replay-v1'|task_id) over archived-AMB tier-A tasks

scg_fingerprint_sample.rule: deterministic ascending sha256('scg-fingerprint-v1'|task_id); one representative task per distinct regenerated v6 model; first 120 distinct v6 models in tier A
scg_fingerprint_sample.interpretation: classes_full_dbm_equal compares the canonical DBM signature of every state class; a difference means the strong-time successor semantics changed the archived SCG, so the archived SCG workload counters for the conflict tier are not reusable.

definition.archived: archived_reference_record.terminal_pairs = sum over candidate words of |normal paths| * |fault paths| (complete enumeration, v4 semantics, no enclosure screen)
definition.recomputed: recomputed counters terminal_pairs + enclosure_rejected_pairs = the same normal x fault pair universe under v6 semantics (first-pass counters for VER rows, complete pass for AMB rows)
definition.feasible_recomputed: len(certificates) in the complete pass = LP-feasible ambiguity critical pairs under v6 semantics; the archived CSV does not persist this per-row count, so it has no archived counterpart
